corrections: Two false extra high-speed center segments and their artificial joint are replaced by each completeM575 rear rod; M576 belongs to front controls.
The duplicated reverse rocker is reassigned to the missing clutch route.
Long low rear rods are M573; M57449.5in belongs to front controls.
Center clutch rod is SH229A93in from SNL192, not the older handbookM574 application.
Integral M641 journal and its split keeper replace the invented transverse fulcrum pin; complete floor rivets and rod cotters supplied.
Complete source-sized intermediate cap screws, actual strips/floor receivers and clutch mounting bolt sets added.
True shaft-axis-plane Woodruff keys, complete clamp stock, real rod receiver axes, thread engagement and floor bores checked.
scope: Closure of withheld commit redo as local static reconstruction. Does not complete driver controls, operating motion or whole tank.
